Admittedly, there has only been a sample study of the persons who are likely to be affected by the acquisition.

Out of the total area to be acquired, 785 plots have not been identified and it is not even known who the owners of the said plots are and how they will be W.P.(C)Nos.29569/2021 & affected by the acquisition.
That is to say, almost two-thirds of the plots involved have not even been the subject matter of the study.

It does not stand to reason how a social impact study as contemplated in the Act can be completed/concluded by studying the impact on the persons who are occupying about one-third of the plots sought to be acquired.
